summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited, a South African foreign private issuer, reporting a fatal mining incident at its TauTona service shaft. The filing discloses the tragic loss of an employee and notes that authorities have been notified and support provided. It is a routine disclosure of an operational safety event, not a special situation. It is equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 8.01 disclosure of a workplace fatality. There are no deal terms, strategic actions, or corporate events. Classification confirms it is not a special situation, as it solely reports a non-financial operational incident.
